apiContracts: Authenticated GET/POST /api/reading-position; client never supplies an owner identifier; optimistic revision is carried unchanged.
dataEntities: reading_positions; browser local storage is an offline/anonymous cache only.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Uses the existing reading_positions table from the reader progress API; no duplicate entity or migration.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Unauthenticated reading remains available with local-only progress. Authenticated clients use server progress when available.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the reader client and versioned bundle together; API remains backward-compatible.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Reader requests owner-scoped progress after chapter authorization and restores percentage only for the current chapter.
uiLifecycle.servedBundleParity: public/app.js and public/app-17.23.0.js must remain byte-identical; service worker refreshes its precache.

privacySecurity.authentication: Server session is authoritative; client uses /api/me only to detect signed-in state.
privacySecurity.authorization: All data access remains enforced by the reading-position API.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: No user ID is accepted from the browser; server derives owner from session.
privacySecurity.csrf: Uses same-origin API calls and existing Worker write-origin enforcement.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Autosave is debounced; server rate limits and validates every write.

unit: Reader progress client source regression test
integration: GET restore and POST save endpoint wiring
Optimistic revision included in every write
Reconnect path retries server discovery without blind stale-write replay
isolation: Server API owns cross-account isolation; client sends no owner identifier.

stagingSteps: Validate all governed workflows on exact PR head.
Perform authenticated browser tests on two accounts and two devices before production release.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert this client integration and synchronized served bundle; preserve server API.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No data mutation or schema rollback is required.
monitoringSignals: Reader autosave success and reconnect recovery

collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: public/app.js is experience-shell-owned and is changed with ADR-0005.

changeSummary: Connects the reader browser to the session-owned progress API with debounced optimistic autosave, local fallback and reconnect recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Scroll autosaves are debounced and revision guarded.
Offline and anonymous readers retain local-only progress.
Stale revision conflicts are not blindly replayed.
Canonical and served versioned bundles remain byte-identical.
